ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast macro-level ratio of approximately 1:1.1 high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric blobs concentrated on the lateral lobes; right lobe exhibits approximately 70% white coverage while the left lobe exhibits approximately 45% white coverage. Central peduncle region and trailing edge margins are characterized by solid black/low-intensity pixel clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 55 degrees; notch depth is distinct and clearly divides the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular peaks and valleys (serrations) along the entire trailing edge; right lobe trailing edge contains higher-amplitude valleys compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edges follow a concave curve toward the median notch, while the leading edges maintain a smooth convex sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, high-contrast, textured pixel groupings located at the distal tips of both fluke lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several unaligned, vertical, high-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks/scratches) visible on the central black-pigmented peduncle region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent clusters of biological growth (barnacles) at the lobe tips and distinct vertical linear scarring on the central ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant asymmetry in the white-to-black pigmentation distribution between the left and right lobes.
